selectionOutcomes.description: Establishes the caller identity required by the handler.
Resolves the target user, caller membership, and target membership used in authorization and deletion.
Determines whether the target membership belongs to the caller.
Applies the administrator check only when the caller targets a different user.
Deletes the resolved target membership and identifies the actor passed to the store.
Defines how an authenticated current user is required.
Binds the requested member resource to a space accessible through the caller's membership.
Resolves and validates the target user named by the request.
Loads the target membership in the resolved space and requires it to be active.
Loads the caller's membership in the same space and requires it to be active.
Defines the administrator authority required by the non-self branch.
Defines administrator and ordinary-user roles as active memberships.
Shows externally visible mapping for relevant store-side deletion constraints or permission failures.
Validates deletion identifiers and delegates the membership deletion to the store driver with the caller's user ID as actor.
